s0296DF.name: Smoke sprite types 1-2 (puff, burst)
summary: Handlers for smoke sprite slots $17C0,X types 1 and 2, called from the smoke dispatcher at $0296C0 (pointer table at $0296CB).
Type 1: a 16x16 puff, frame = timer / 4, drawn from the timer [$17CC,X]; blinks via X-flip in its last 8 frames.
Type 2: four 8x8 tiles ($7C/$7D) forming a 16x16 burst that flips with the timer. Uses OAM $02F0, or $0390 in boss rooms.
Slot is freed when the timer ends or the sprite leaves the screen. The first routine at $0296DF only frees the slot.

s0298C2.name: Tables: sparkle X and Y offsets
summary: Per-step offsets applied by the type 5 smoke handler: X = 04,08,04,00; Y = FC,04,0C,04.

s0298CA.name: Smoke type 5: sparkle spawner
summary: Smoke type 5, created when a coin is collected. Every 4th frame while its timer counts down it spawns a minor extended sprite (type 2, timer $17)
at an offset around the smoke position. Reuses the oldest slot ([$185D] round-robin) when all 12 slots are busy.

s029922.name: Table: rising smoke tiles
summary: Tiles for smoke type 3, indexed by timer / 4.

s029927.name: Smoke type 3 and spinning coin loop
summary: Smoke type 3: 8x8 puff that rises 1 pixel every 8 frames and changes tile with the timer. Draws into the $0200 or $0300 OAM area depending on [$A5], [$140F], [$0D9B].
$0299D2 (separate routine): main loop over the 4 spinning coin slots of coins from blocks, calling CODE_0299F1 for each used slot ([$17D0,X] != 0).
$0299E3: clears the current spinning coin slot.

s0299E9.name: Table: spinning coin OAM indexes
summary: OAM indexes of the 4 spinning coin slots: $30,$38,$40,$48. The other 4 bytes ($EC,$EA,$E8,$EC) look unused.

s0299F1.name: Spinning coin from block
summary: Handles one spinning coin slot X ([$17D0,X] != 0). Unless sprites are locked: applies speed and gravity (+3 per frame); once Y speed reaches $20 the coin is collected (CODE_029AA8).
Draws a 16x16 face tile $E8 relative to its layer ([$17E4,X] picks layer 1 or 2). Frame (slot + [RAM_FrameCounterB]) / 4 AND 3 selects the face or the edge-on frame.
Erases the coin if it is off-screen horizontally; does not draw if off-screen vertically.
Parameters: X: coin slot.

RollingCoinTiles.name: Coin edge frames, coin collect, extended sprite loop
summary: $029A6E: tiles for the edge-on coin ($EA, $FA, $EA); drawn as two 8x8 halves by $029A71, the bottom half Y-flipped.
$029AA8: coin collected: spawns a 10 point score sprite at the coin, a sparkle (smoke type 5) via $029ADA, clears the coin slot.
$029ADA: finds a free smoke slot and makes it type 5 (timer $10), at the coin position minus [$26]/[$28] on layer 2.
$029B0A: main loop over the 10 extended sprite slots (X = 9..0, [$15E9] = X) calling $029B16.
$029B16: per-slot dispatcher: skips empty slots, counts down the timer [$176F,X] unless sprites are locked, then jumps via ExtendedSpritePtrs.

ExtendedSpritePtrs.name: Pointer table: extended sprite routines
summary: Main routine for each extended sprite number, indexed by [RAM_ExSpriteNum,X].

VolcanoLotusFire.name: Extended sprite: Volcano Lotus fire
summary: Extended sprite $0C: a seed fired by a Volcano Lotus. Draws an 8x8 tile ($A6/$B6, alternating) on the extended OAM area, frees itself when off-screen,
is destroyed by the cape, moves by its X and Y speed, accelerates downward (+1 every 4 frames up to $18) and, when falling, wobbles +/-8 in X speed every 8 frames.

s029BDE.name: Tables: Yoshi stomp smoke offsets
summary: Per trail (0 = right, 1 = left): X offset from Mario ($08,$F8), its high byte ($00,$FF) and starting X speed ($18,$E8).

s029BE4.name: Yoshi ground stomp: shake and smoke
summary: Starts the screen shake (ground shake timer = 5), plays sound $09 on [$1DFC] and spawns two smoke trail extended sprites (type $0F) at Mario's feet,
moving left and right. $029BF5 does the spawn for the trail in [$00]; it does nothing if all 8 slots checked are busy.
Parameters: none (falls through to spawn the second trail).

SmokeTrailTiles.name: Table: smoke trail tiles
summary: 11 tile numbers indexed by timer / 2: $66,$64,$62, then $60 for the rest.

SmokeTrail.name: Extended sprite: smoke trail
summary: Extended sprite $0F (Yoshi stomp smoke). Draws a 16x16 tile chosen by its timer, with flip bits cycling every 4 frames, moves horizontally, halves its X speed when the
timer reaches 6, and is freed when the timer hits 0.

SpinJumpStars.name: Extended sprite: spin jump star
summary: Extended sprite $10. Draws star tile $EF (palette 2) and moves by its X/Y speed, slowing down as its timer runs out
(movement mask from DATA_029CB0 indexed by timer / 4). Freed when the timer is 0.

s029CB0.name: Table: spin jump star movement masks
summary: Indexed by timer / 4: $FF,$07,$01,$00,$00; the star only moves on frames where [RAM_FrameCounter] AND mask = 0.
